violations.description: The code uses Delta Lake MERGE for upsert, but does not implement SCD Type 2 logic (no handling of current_flag, end_date, or record expiration). Platform rules require SCD Type 2 to use MERGE with subquery logic for record expiration and new inserts concurrently.
violations.suggestion: Implement SCD Type 2 by adding current_flag, start_date, end_date columns, and use MERGE logic to expire old records and insert new versions.

violations.description: Type casting is performed, but DECIMAL(19,4) is used directly in .cast(), which is not supported by PySpark. PySpark expects 'decimal' or 'DecimalType(19,4)'.
violations.suggestion: Use DecimalType(19,4) for casting decimal columns, e.g., .cast(DecimalType(19,4)).
